title: Pre-registered parity gates (architecture.md v2.1 §6.6), machine-readable copy
engine_results_at_registration: none (engine module .cc files absent; no engine trace exists)
rules: Values are copied from architecture.md v2.1 §6.6 and the spec section each gate cites; only the evaluation mechanics (percentile convention, frame-index windows, proxies) are made explicit here, before any engine or absolute-scale result.

Tolerances and classes are never changed after results are seen (repo CLAUDE.md §2-3, architecture.md P-5). A failing gate is reported as FAIL; BLOCKED never replaces FAIL; BLOCKED reasons are only the ones written here.

Trace gates evaluate GlueRunner output written by tools/harness/replay in the schema of the original trace; module gates (evaluator module-report) take their verdict from the owning WP GTest run (command + output), not from this harness.

Parity runs: drop-mask = reference r1 (frames with fresh == false in r1 are skipped, their sensor events go to the next processed frame), pyramid model kSwiftShaderApprox (D-9); ideal-mode and IEEE runs are reported only (§6.2).
Reference runs are r1 and r2 of build/slam-refact-20261015/reference/runs/<scenario>; wrap1 is excluded everywhere; profile1 only where the design numbers include it (A-*).

classes.MUST-PASS: deterministic oracle or invariant; all must PASS for completion
classes.REPORT: statistic / event / similarity; evaluate all and record PASS/FAIL as is
classes.BLOCKED-ALLOWED->MUST-PASS: may be BLOCKED for lack of an execution means (reason recorded); when executed it is MUST-PASS
classes.BLOCKED-ALLOWED->REPORT: may be BLOCKED (reason recorded); when executed it is REPORT

trace_schema.engine_rules: same keys in the same order; browser-only keys (publishMs, acceptedMs, callbackMs, latencyMs, xrGpuStageMs, xrCpuStageMs) null; extra keys prefixed "sr"; fresh = the input frame was processed (not drop-masked), so the startup re-publication of frame 5 is fresh like in the original trace (PublishedFrame.repeated is srRepeated)

tolerance.no_latch: neither original latches => PASS iff the engine does not latch
tolerance.originals_disagree_on_latch: exactly one original latches => engine PASS iff it does not latch, or it latches and meets the primary rule against the latched original
